source: Native app diagnostics observed through CUA, 2026-10-27
result: Native negotiation and decoding worked; user reported flickering and observed UI was blank between image uploads. Playback stopped for fix.
root_cause: Unallocated image handles replaced the display before Iced completed asynchronous GPU uploads. RGBA 1280x720 exceeds iced_wgpu synchronous upload threshold of 2 MiB.
fix: Allocate each frame first, retain current allocation until ready callback, allow only one upload in flight and retain only latest decoded frame.
